Arsenale

Where Venice built a ship a day

At the Arsenale, at the height of the Republic, a galley was launched every day: the first assembly line in history, five centuries before Detroit. This frame comes from there: squared geometry, a wide bridge, no concessions. Built to outlast anyone judging it.
